rejections.B_numba_layout_integration: Dominated by C at every gated boundary at equal budget; unconditional integration is disqualified by the measured warm_parallel regression (101.59 vs A 29.05 ms); conditional (size/thread-aware) dispatch would be new unmeasured behavior. Win region recorded: 4T parallel mid-blocks 1.59x over A (single size measured) and kernel-only 4.8-5.0x at 1T. Future condition that could flip this: B7-24 decode-side block-major emit eliminating pack cost from the adapter boundary, plus a pack='numpy'/serial-pack heuristic measured on the real scene; not executed in this round per budget discipline.

drjit_appendix.trials: evidence/trials/b7_31_appendix_drjit.json (4 configs, 3 paired warm reps, equal budgets via dr.set_thread_count, all digests bitwise-equal across A / C_native / C_drjit)
drjit_appendix.verdict: C_drjit REJECTED for integration: loses to baseline A at every matched-budget boundary (2.6x slower at the pipeline block size, 3.8x on the warm sequence, 1.85x at large B) and to C_native everywhere. The author dev-tier claim of 2-10x faster at B=96/128 does not reproduce at the honest adapter boundary on the real call sequence; per-call JIT dispatch + pack transpose dominate. The review-approved exactness (520/520 bitwise, FastMath-off IR evidence) is confirmed by the trials digests.
drjit_appendix.notes: F5 (two-pool budgets) and F6 (warm DRJIT disk cache, process-cold only) labels apply; F1 evidence-prose repair pending with the author.
